speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative infectious workup and your presentation of fatigable weakness and diplopia, I suspect a neuromuscular junction disorder. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies. REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_nerve_stimulation_EMG.

text: RESULTS: Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody: Positive. Electromyography and Nerve Conduction Studies: Decreased response with repetitive nerve stimulation, suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder.

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive acetylcholine receptor antibodies and EMG findings confirm a diagnosis of Myasthenia Gravis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
